translation: The Hand Examination Chart says: The lung is the canopy of the five viscera: above it responds to heaven, it regulates and orders the myriad things, and governs the movement of essence-qi; it models the five phases, responds to the four seasons, and knows the five flavors; within the qi opening (qikou), yin and yang meet and join, and within it there are five regions; front and back, left and right, each has what it governs, and above, below, and center are divided into nine paths. Examining it, one knows where the pathogenic disease is. Li Binhu said: The single vessel of the qi opening is divided into nine paths, governing in general the twelve channels and the eight extraordinary vessels.
